drhp.business: InterGlobe Aviation operates scheduled passenger and cargo air services under the IndiGo brand across an extensive network spanning key economic hubs and emerging regional markets in India and internationally, covering 144 destinations (98 domestic and 46 international) in FY 2026. Since inception in 2006 the airline has grown on the back of a robust, largely Airbus narrow-body fleet, outstanding aircraft utilisation and a cost-efficient approach, serving leisure, business and VFR travellers alongside charter and air-cargo customers. risks.note: Conflicts in West Asia have raised crude oil prices and increased freight and insurance costs; IMF estimates project headline inflation rising to 4.4% in CY 2026 with energy prices up 19% and oil prices up 21.4% on production and logistics disruptions. Fuel is the largest swing item in an airline's cost base.
risks.risk: Fuel and energy price shock driven by geopolitical conflict

risks.note: During FY 2026 geopolitical developments led to closure of airspace at Pakistan and the Middle East, forcing re-routing, longer flight durations, elevated fuel consumption, higher operating costs and in some cases service cancellations.
risks.risk: Airspace closures and route disruption from geopolitical events

risks.note: The Company experienced a brief period of unforeseen and unprecedented operational disruption in early December 2025 that inconvenienced customers, employees and partners, for which the Board issued a formal apology - evidence that a concentrated network can be disrupted at scale by a single event.
risks.risk: Operational resilience and single-event disruption risk

risks.note: Customer complaints filed during FY 2026 rose to 44,729 from 1,803 in FY 2025 under the BRSR grievance disclosure, a step-change that carries brand, regulatory and compensation consequences for an airline whose franchise rests on reliability.

The BRSR notes that Mr. Pieter Elbers, Chief Executive Officer, resigned from his services effective 10th March 2026, and the KMP composition disclosed as on 31st March 2026 excludes him - a senior-leadership gap during a phase of international scale-up.

Under an adverse scenario of sustained energy price shocks the IMF sees global growth slowing to 2.5% in CY 2026 with inflation at 5.4%, and to around 2% with inflation above 6% by CY 2027 in a severe scenario, with emerging economies hit nearly twice as hard; conflicts in West Asia have also contributed to volatility in capital flows.
risks.risk: Global macroeconomic downside and capital-flow volatility

risks.note: IndiGo is tracking global climate regulations such as CORSIA, ReFuelEU and the UK RTFO and is preparing to meet applicable compliances; Sustainable Aviation Fuel is being deployed only on flights returning from the EU and UK, and the Indian SAF supply ecosystem is still being developed with regulators and Oil Marketing Companies.

Scheduled and charter air services for passengers and cargo accounted for 97.35% of turnover per the BRSR, leaving the Company with no meaningful earnings diversification away from air transport cycles.
risks.risk: Structural exposure to a single business line

sk.overview: India's logistics market is a dynamic ecosystem catering to B2B, B2C and C2C segments, estimated at Rs 21-23 trillion (US$247-270 billion) in FY2025 after growing at a 2.5-5% CAGR since FY2020. Online B2C logistics, segmented into e-commerce and on-demand hyperlocal delivery, handled 8-9 billion shipments in FY2025, with e-commerce logistics (excluding grocery) at 4.9-5.3 billion shipments and projected to reach 15-16 billion by FY2030.
